body:
I pushed an editorial fix in e6c5508.

Defects D1 and D2 are open, no fix yet.

D1: The new call doesn't say which navigable the synchronous navigation steps involve, but [append session history synchronous navigation steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#tn-append-session-history-sync-nav-steps) takes a target navigable, and [apply the history step](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#sync-navigations-jump-queue) uses it to decide whether the steps can jump the queue. The other callers say "involving `navigable`". Should this say "involving `navigable`" too? Open, no fix yet.

D2: There are no tests. Could a wpt test cover the race from #12362, e.g. a same-document navigation that starts after an intercepted traversal commits but before it resumes? Open, no fix yet.
